description: Search GLEIF LEI records by company name (legal or other names) and/or national business register number (e.g. Finnish Y-tunnus 0112038-9, UK company number, French SIREN). Filter by legal-address country (ISO 3166 alpha-2) and entity status. Returns company-level records with LEI.

country.description: Legal-address country, ISO alpha-2, e.g. FI

name.description: Company name or part of it

registeredAs.description: National register number as recorded at the business registry

name: gleif_search
